title: AiRunStatusItem

formId.description: Form id processed by this item.

phase.description: Current preparation phase for this form.

lastError.description: Most recent item-level error, if any.

encrypted.description: True when the form is encrypted and the server cannot read its source content.

translationEnqueued.description: Translation tasks queued for this form.

lastSubmissionUuid.description: Submission identifier marking text-preparation progress, if available. Informational; not needed for polling or cancellation.

itemIndex.description: Zero-based position of this item in the submitted request.

lastAudioAttachmentId.description: Audio attachment identifier marking transcription-preparation progress, if available. Informational; not needed for polling or cancellation.

transcriptionEnqueued.description: Transcription tasks queued for this form.

message.description: Progress or outcome message for this form.

attempts.description: Number of consecutive temporary errors while preparing work for this form. Resets when preparation makes progress.

description: Per-form progress within an AI run.
